text:
mike_ae: Heads-up: FinReg (prospect) escalated BYOK/HSM questions in pre-sales. They want: (1) explicit statement that key material never leaves customer HSM, (2) rotation model + max rotation window, (3) rough pricing delta vs hosted keys for ~100k tokens/day. Procurement meeting Fri noon ET. Can we assemble bullet answers + one-pager?

clare_sec: Short answers: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via HSM proxy or cloud-KMS bindings. We can provide a redacted HSM attestation and a statement confirming we never export or persist customer private key material outside the HSM (we call/wrap, never extract). FIPS 140-2/3 status: our supported HSM vendors are FIPS-validated; attestation will name vendor & firmware versions (redacted for public).

clare_sec: Rotation: customers control rotation. Default recommended rotation cadence is 30 days for high-security customers, 90 days common. We can support on-demand rotation APIs and automated schedules in SOW. For emergency rotations we support immediate rewrap inside HSM; key rollover process documented in runbook.

tom_field: For procurement the doc should include POC scope and perf impact. Quick summary from staging BYOK proxy run: single-region proxy adds ~18ms median per request (TLS + HSM RPC), 95th ~45ms for small payloads. Multi-AZ failover to remote HSM adds another 25-60ms depending on egress. We'll capture numbers with 1k sample requests.

nina_sre: Network checklist (short):
- Allow outbound TLS 443 to our proxy IPs (we'll provide CIDR).
- If customer requires peering/private-link, we can arrange (adds setup time).
- Metrics collector needs a single inbound from our metrics agent (allow collector IP).
- Salt for key wrapping stays in customer control.
(Will post exact IPs + terraform snippet by 3pm PT.)

olivia_legal: Contract notes: two options. Option A: No-escrow default; we state customer owns keys, Redwood will not retain plaintext or escrow. Option B: Escrow addendum available with additional fees and strict access controls (requires cust sign-off). Also provide proof-of-destruction language (on termination we certify we dropped any wrapped keys and logs showing deletion). I'll draft both short clauses.

mike_ae: Pricing ask 5k: they want a ballpark premium vs hosted keys for 100k tokens/day with reserved throughput. Are there standard numbers we can give?

tom_field: Ballpark: BYOK with HSM proxy -> operational premium roughly 10-18% on per-token processing cost due to added latency and HSM ops. For 100k tokens/day that translates to roughly $400-$1,200/month incremental, plus a one-time onboarding/integration fee (range $1.5k-$3k depending on network/attestation). Dedicated reserved throughput is separate and typically starts at $X/month (finance to populate).

clare_sec: Also call out: if they require managed HSM (we host HSM on behalf), add recurring HSM hosting fee and higher SLA. If they BYO cloud-KMS key material (no external HSM proxy), overhead is lower but still expect 5-10% premium for key call latency.

mike_ae: OK. Deliverables: 1) one-page attestation + 2-3 sentence public summary (clare), 2) 1-page perf & network checklist (tom/nina), 3) two short contract clauses (olivia), 4) ballpark pricing lines (tom + finance). Who owns cleanup and upload to drive?

nina_sre: I'll upload IP list + quick terraform snippet to Drive and paste link here by 2:30pm PT.

clare_sec: I'll draft and upload redacted attestation + public blurb by 4pm PT.

olivia_legal: Draft clauses by 4pm PT.

ops-bot: staging/byok-proxy deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/ops/instances/ab12 (creds delivered to secure channel)

mike_ae: Great, I'll consolidate and send a procurement-ready note after your uploads. Please ping if anything blocks the attestation redaction. Thanks all :thumbsup:

tom_field: FYI I'll include the curl example we used (will redact IDs):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"ping","kms_key":"projects/prod/keys/REDACTED"}'
```

clare_sec: one more note: we should flag that BYOK/HSM setups can increase onboarding time by 3-10 business days for network/legal/ops coordination. Call that out in SOW.

mike_ae: Perfect. I'll coord with procurement and circle back after the meeting.
